title: Steam Train Days Out: Heritage Railways for Families
description: Family days out on heritage steam railways: what to expect, Santa Specials and other themed events, famous routes like the Jacobite, and tips.
h1: Steam train days out for families
intro: Clouds of steam, a whistle and a ride through the countryside. Heritage railways are a wonderfully old-fashioned family day out that toddlers and grandparents love equally.

image.alt: A heritage steam train passing through a forest

cardText: Heritage railways, themed events and famous routes like the Jacobite.

blocks.title: Scout’s steam tip
blocks.text: Check the timetable. Most heritage lines don’t run every day, especially outside summer, and special event days need booking ahead.
points: Sit near the engine for the best steam and sounds
Many stations have cafés and small museums

sections.html: Heritage railways run restored steam and diesel trains along preserved lines, usually run by charities and volunteers. A return trip can take an hour or two, with stops at old-style stations, and often there’s a museum, café or picnic spot along the way.

• Santa Specials in December. Book early: see our Christmas days out.
  • Character and storybook days.
  • Halloween ghost trains and Easter egg hunts.
  • Gala weekends with extra engines in steam.

The Jacobite in the Scottish Highlands crosses the Glenfinnan Viaduct seen in the Harry Potter films. See our filming locations guide. Many other lines cross viaducts and coastline or climb into the hills.
Look for family tickets, “rover” tickets for unlimited travel on the day, and under-5s free. Some heritage railways accept Blue Peter badges. Check the BBC’s list.

faqs.q: Do heritage railways run all year?
faqs.a: Most run mainly from spring to autumn, plus special events like Santa Specials in December. Always check the railway’s timetable before you go.

faqs.q: Are steam trains good for toddlers?
faqs.a: Yes. Shorter return trips, station play areas and the excitement of the engine make them a great toddler day out.
